properties.site-address: Oak View Stud Farm, Lombard Street, Horton Kirby
properties.notes: The site comprises a former stud farm containing a number of workshops in varying commercial uses and a large number of storage containers. To the rear is a large agricultural field used for grazing horses. Bounded by Lombard Street to the west, residential development to the north, and open countryside to the east and south.
